LOW_Guildhall_GravediggerKarcen
Gravedigger Karcen is a human fighter and Zhentarim mercenary that can be found in the Guildhall, during Act Three. He guards and patrols the southern half of the Guildhall in the event of a possible  Stone Lord attack.

Involvement

Protecting the Guildhall

Karcen can be seen patrolling the southern and southwestern half of the Guildhall, as well as the central pit. Him and the rest of the Zhents in the Guildhall having been hired by  Nine-Fingers Keene in order to deter and resist any future Stone Lord intrusions, he nevertheless makes his displeasure for the boring posting known to the party and that he'd prefer it if they attacked the Harpers instead.[1][2] If Jaheira is in the party and rebukes him, Karcen will be intimidated and uncertain, not realizing that Jaheira was one until she spoke up.[3]

On his patrol route, Karcen will often stop by  Carlorina the Wolf, scheming and telling her to be sharp and to be ready for a signal.[4]

Battle for the Guildhall

When  Roah Moonglow,  Boss Friol, or  Trinoda attempts to take over the Guildhall, Karcen will join the fight alongside his Zhentarim allies against the Guild on the south-western side, facing against  Lady Flux. Siding against the Zhentarim will end in Karcen's demise, or in his disappearance if he's knocked out.

Provided the party aids the Zhentarim win the battle, and he survives the fight in Guildhall, Karcen will stand at the door leading into the guildmaster's office. Talking with him afterwards will have him mention that he'd actually like to stay here, and will request a posting in the Guildhall as there is good money to be made.[5]

If either  Fishbait Arno or  Slick Inatra perished during the battle in the Guildhall, Gravedigger Karcen can take their place and be summoned with  Gather Your Allies variant  Black Fist Enforcers, if the party completed Aid the Underduke and sided with the Zhentarim.

Notes

  • Carlorina the Wolf and Gravedigger Karcen are seemingly meant to be on alert for an unexplained signal, potentially the one to turn on the Guild, even though their local leader Slick Inatra seem to be unaware.
  • If sided with, Gravedigger Karcen is one of the most powerful Zhents during the battle, and is the Zhentarim' biggest damage-dealer. However, his damage is off-set as he usually battles Lady Flux, whose  Rage: Wolf Heart diminishes his slashing damage.
  • Unlike most Fighter NPCs in the game, Gravedigger Karcen doesn't rely on the NPC variants of Superiority Die attacks that allow them to use their Manoeuvres once per round without needing or expending a Superiority Die. Instead, he uses the player variant that allows him to use Manoeuvres as much as he wants, at the cost of Superiority Die resources.
